modelClaim.name: Kling 4.0
modelClaim.sourceTextOriginal:
Kling 4.0 vs Kling 3.0: same image, same prompt, one generation each.

I ran eight image-to-video tests on both models at 10 seconds, 1080p: photoreal dialogue, 2D animation, 3D animation, a product shot, fast action, a landscape, a multi-shot scene and an FPV one-take. First result used, nothing re-rolled. Side by side below, sound compared in the thread.

@Kling_ai

🧵

originalPrompt: The drone pushes forward low over the water toward the cliff as a big wave hits the rocks and explodes into spray that drifts across the frame; grey light steady. Smooth forward camera move with a slight rise. One continuous take, wind and sea sound.
